subject: No display when use external file

messages.author: 01008d65e17de2b6
messages.subject: No display when use external file
parts:
Hi,

I don't get display when use source command to run an external
file. The file I try to run is an example from ggplot2 website:

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg))
p + geom_boxplot()

I saved it to a test.R and try source(test.R) in R console but I
don't get the display. I can get display with plot function in a R
file and I also can get display when run the above command in console.
I don't know why when put these command in a file it doesn't work. I
also try to save the display to a png file and it didn't work either.

png('test1.png')
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg))
p + geom_boxplot()
dev.off()

Any help is greatly appreciated.

Tao

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: No display when use external file
parts:
Hi,

you need to call print(p) explicitly in non-interactive use.

png('test1.png')
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg)) + geom_boxplot()
print(p)
dev.off()


HTH,

baptiste
